payload.summary: DRAFTED POSITION (claude, pre-grill): reserve the rotated card's painted width with margin-inline: calc((var(--card-h) - var(--card-w))/2) = 20px each side, and DELETE the translate(6px,-4px) nudge as the overlap compensation it was, leaving rotate(90deg) alone, mirrored per seat. rotate() leaves the layout box at 92px while the card paints 132px wide, which is the whole defect. Counters to be pressed: does dropping the nudge change the look; is margin-inline the right lever; and what happens vertically when a 92px-tall painted card sits in a 132px min-height row. Brief Q4.
